# ADR-0048 — S1.7 Session A build findings

## Status
Proposed

## Date
2026-09-25

## Slice
S1.7

## Context
Kind: deviation
- Spec says (file lines are those of `main` at `2edaa24`, before this PR):
  - **Download route.** `docs/build/04-server-contracts.md` §2.3 D2 (04:486) — "`{kind:'skin', bucket:'skins', path: texture_path, filename:'<slug>.png', counter:'record_skin_download'}`", D4 / D5 — the two kinds' counters and URL steps as prose; ADR-0027 D5 — "The `Downloadable` counter-payload/URL-kind generalisation (01 INV-56 for kind `skin`) is deferred to S1.7"; `lib/files.ts` on `main` — `Downloadable` is the one `project_file` shape.
  - **Ownership.** `docs/questions.md` 2026-08-20 (the S1.2 security round) — every owner-writable `*_path` column gets the `profiles_avatar_path_own` pattern plus an ownership re-check before any service-role Storage delete; `docs/data-model.md` §2.4 (data-model:130–131) lists `texture_path`, `render_bust_path`, `image_path` with no CHECK.
  - **Schema.** data-model §2.4 — the column lists without CHECK names, indexes or enum names; §4 (data-model:250) — the service-role RPC list ends at `reorder_mentions`; `docs/build/05-test-plan.md` §3 SEED-7 / SEED-8 (05:110–111) leave `sort_order`, `description_md`, `year` (avatar), `created_at` open.
  - **Actions.** 04 §1.5 `createSkin` / `updateSkin` Input (04:390) — one flat `{id?, slug, name, description_md?, model, is_exclusive, status, sort_order, texture?}` shape, no reorder form; `createArt` / `updateArt` Input (04:401) — "begin/commit fields per §1.4.5", no reorder form; §1.5 Validation (04:391) — "exactly 64×64 px … 64×32 legacy rejected with message "Skins need to be 64×64."" with no order against `validateUpload`; §5.5 (04:683) — "`skins`/`art` create/update | `upload:skins`, `upload:art` | 60 / h per admin" with no word on which calls count.
  - **Job + script.** 04 §3.8 (04:597–600) — Logic / Idempotency rows ("Writes a `sync_runs` row `source='skins'` **only** when run from the script"); 05 T-UNIT-45 (05:535) — "the script never reads `process.env` directly (uses `lib/env.ts`)"; `docs/build/01-architecture.md` §1 tree (01:44) — the scripts line without a loader.
  - **Islands.** `docs/build/03-components.md` C-16a — the client-island list names `components/skins-art/SkinViewer3D.tsx` and `ArtMasonry.Lightbox.tsx` only; 03 §2.7 `SkinViewer3D` (03:237) — "`next/dynamic(() => import('skinview3d'), { ssr:false })`", props without `variant`; `SkinCard` (03:238) — "Missing bust → `Skeleton` media until the render job fills it"; `ArtMasonry` (03:239) — `filter: 'all' | …`; 03 §2.10 `UploadWell` (03:266) — `kind: keyof typeof UPLOAD_KINDS`, `action` required, one two-phase behaviour; 03 §3 (03:311) — `SkinViewer3D` states only; `docs/build/02-routes-and-pages.md` §1.1 `/skins` / `/art` rows (02:67–68) and §1.3 `/admin/skins` / `/admin/art` rows (02:94–95) — component lists without the islands; 02 RP-02 / RP-03 — ISR pages never read `searchParams`.
  - **Public surfaces.** `DESIGN.md` §6 #5 — "Name + description + DOWNLOAD PNG + Slim toggle sit under the viewer"; §6 #6 — the filter row "all / avatars / thumbnails / icons" and the masonry; 03 §2.7 `ArtCard` (03:240) — the image only (the pass-3 "07 — ART GALLERY" artboard draws a caption strip); 05 T-E2E-9 (05:560) — "filter row `all / avatars / thumbnails / icons`".
  - **Tests.** 05 §7.1 T-RLS-121 / 122 (05:318–319) — bucket cells with no file named; T-RLS-129 (05:330) — no `record_skin_download` behaviour, no `reorder_skins` / `reorder_art`; T-ACT-56 / 58 / 59 / 61 / 73 / 76 (05:442–453, 417, 423) as written; T-E2E-7 (05:558) — one test, no order clause, no reduced-motion leg; T-E2E-8 (05:559) — "route table check in CI-4 output + network log"; T-E2E-46 (05:574) — still lists the S0 placeholder pages; §8 row S1.7 (05:656); §1.3 factories (05:46) — `makeSkin`, `makeArt` names only; `playwright.config.ts` on `main` — no launch args.
- Found (Session A build pass, branch `feat/S1.7-skins-art`, 2026-09-25 — six parallel build agents on one brief; every decision below was either pre-decided in the brief or reported by an agent as taken beyond it): (1) the route needs one `Downloadable` shape that names its own RPC payload and URL kind, or it grows an `if kind ===` chain per kind (ADR-0027 D5 owed this). (2) A row's `*_path` under the service client can point at another row's folder unless the DB says no — the S1.2 rule was never applied to a table with two path columns and a path whose id is minted inside it (art). (3) `createSkin` must insert before it uploads: a slug conflict answered after an upload leaves an orphan object under a folder that will never have a row. (4) The verbatim "Skins need to be 64×64." and `validateUpload`'s own type copy cannot both come first — a JPEG named `.png` has no IHDR to read. (5) `createArt`'s id lives inside the pending path, so a swapped FREE id is indistinguishable from an un-PUT `begin` — "forbidden" is only provable for a path under an EXISTING row's folder. (6) `lib/data/**` may not import `lib/files.ts` (it sits behind the 01 INV-14 admin-client fence), so the readers build public URLs with `publicStorageUrl` from `lib/data/projects.ts`. (7) `/skins` and `/art` are ISR and may not read `searchParams`, so two islands own `?skin=` and `?kind=`; skinview3d needs its own leaf so the one `next/dynamic` site imports a file, not the package. (8) The `SkinCard` "Skeleton until the job fills it" reading gives a skin without a bust nothing to show; 00 S1.7.AC3 says "client-render fallback". (9) On a 1200px content width a 4:3 stage is 900px tall, pushing the controls and the details below the fold on every laptop; a delegated click on the `<ul>` is the only way a shared `SkinCard` can select without a function prop crossing the server boundary. (10) A `?kind=render` with no render would empty the masonry under a bar highlighting nothing; a zero-item page needs no bar at all. (11) `UploadWell` is the one component allowed to PUT (03 C-17 exception 4) and the admin forms need it twice over: a pick that hands back a `File` for the inline skin action, and a PUT whose commit the parent form sends with its metadata. (12) Playwright's headless Chromium has no WebGL without a software-GL flag; `next build`'s route table cannot say which chunk holds skinview3d, so T-E2E-8 must read the requested chunks. (13) A factory slug `t_<hex>` fails the slug CHECK (no underscore). (14) The last two S0 placeholder pages were replaced, so `placeholders.spec.ts` had nothing left to assert.
- Related: closes **ADR-0027 D5** (D1) and the `docs/questions.md` 2026-08-20 `*_path` rule (D2); **ADR-0047** (the renderer; D10 / D11 call it); follows ADR-0002 C7 (admin-only), C8 (skin download through the route), C11 (two-phase uploads — no further ADR), C22 as amended by ADR-0047; extends **ADR-0038 D1** ("Saved." wiring += `/admin/skins`, `/admin/art` — D19) and the **ADR-0043 D4 / ADR-0045 D15** island pattern (D13); the reorder RPCs copy **ADR-0045 D2** (D5). 03 §11 O-19 / O-24 are unchanged. `DESIGN.md` is NOT edited: D16's desktop arrangement is read as the §6 #5 layout at laptop width (phone and tablet honour "under the viewer" literally) and D17's caption strip follows the pass-3 artboard — both are queued for DESIGN.md's next revision in `docs/questions.md`. Q4 / Q37 are built as answered. Supersedes nothing.

## Decision
**Brief id → decision** (the build brief's working `D-R<n>` ids, kept for the record; the code comments were rewritten to the decision numbers below at integration — the ADR-0045 precedent — so nothing in the tree cites a `D-R` id): D-R1 → ADR-0047 D1–D9 · D-R2 → D10 · D-R3 → D11 · D-R4 → D1 · D-R5 → D2 · D-R6 → D3 · D-R7 → D6 / D8 · D-R8 → D7 · D-R9 → D9 · D-R10 → D13 · D-R11 → D14 / D15 · D-R12 → D18 · D-R13 → D19 / D27 · D-R14 / D-R15 → D19 / D27 · D-R16 → D16 · D-R17 → D14 · D-R18 → D17 · D-R19 / D-R20 → D12 · D-R21 → D5 · D-R22 → D20 · D-R23 / D-R24 → D21 · D-R25 / D-R27 → D22 · D-R26 → D23.

1. **`Downloadable` is a discriminated union and the route stays kind-blind (closes ADR-0027 D5; 04 §2.3 D2 / D4 / D5 amended).** `lib/files.ts`: `type Downloadable = { kind:'project_file'; bucket:'project-files'; path; filename; urlKind:'signed'; counter:'record_download' } | { kind:'skin'; bucket:'skins'; path; filename; urlKind:'public'; counter:'record_skin_download' }`; `type DownloadCounterContext = { id; ipHash; uaHash }`; `counterArgs(d, ctx)` → `{ p_file_id, p_ip_hash, p_ua_hash }` or `{ p_skin_id }`; `publicObjectUrl(bucket, dbPath)` (a bucket-prefixed DB path → `${NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL}/storage/v1/object/public/<bucket>/<object path>`, throws on a prefix mismatch) and `publicDownloadUrl(bucket, objectPath, filename)` (= the public URL + `?download=<encoded filename>`); `resolveDownloadable(id)` = the unchanged project-file branch, else `skins where id = $1 and status = 'published'` → the skin arm (`path` = `texture_path` minus the bucket prefix, `filename` = `<slug>.png`), else `null`. The route (`app/api/download/[fileId]/route.ts`): D4 is ONE call `admin.rpc(downloadable.counter, counterArgs(downloadable, ctx) as never)` — no `if kind ===` chain; D5 is the one ternary `urlKind === 'signed' ? createDownloadUrl(…) : publicDownloadUrl(…)`; D6 headers identical for both kinds; D3 unchanged (scope `download`, `rate_limit_hits`, both kinds). `record_skin_download` raises P0001 without a custom errcode (the `record_download` twin), so the route maps ANY rpc error to 500 `internal` and never relies on a code. Analytics: no new event — the `/skins` DOWNLOAD PNG is a `TrackedLink event="download"` with `{ project: 'skin:<slug>', source: 'direct', from: 'skin' }` (04 §5.6 as written; the emitter is the stage's details slab, 03's review note) carrying the `download` attribute: the 302 lands on the public URL with `?download=<slug>.png` and Supabase answers `Content-Disposition: attachment` (proven, not assumed — a T-RLS-121 / 122 cell fetches the public URL with `?download=` and asserts the header; T-ACT-76 and T-E2E-7 fetch the route's 302 end to end).
2. **Owner-scoped `*_path` CHECKs + the app-side re-check (closes the 2026-08-20 `*_path` rule for `skins` / `art`; data-model §2.4 amended).** Migration `20260925120000_skins_art.sql`: `skins_texture_path_own` = `texture_path ~ ('^skins/' || id::text || '/texture\.png$')`, `skins_render_bust_path_own` = `render_bust_path is null or render_bust_path ~ ('^skins/' || id::text || '/bust\.png$')`, `art_image_path_own` = `image_path ~ ('^art/' || id::text || '/[0-9a-f]{16}\.(png|jpg|webp)$')` — `png | jpg | webp` only (`.jpeg` is rejected; it matches `mediaExtForMime`, which never emits `jpeg`). App-side twins in `lib/files.ts`: `isOwnSkinPath(skinId, dbPath)` (the texture OR the bust of that id) and `isOwnArtPath(artId, dbPath)`; every service-role Storage delete on those buckets re-checks the CALLER's id first (the `deleteAvatar` / `isOwnAvatarPath` rule): `updateArt` deletes the OLD object only when `stored.image_path !== newPath` AND `isOwnArtPath(id, stored.image_path)` — a non-own stored path is logged (`art_path_not_own`) and left alone, never a delete; identical replacement bytes hash to the same final path (`moveObject` dedupes), so nothing is deleted then. `lib/actions/skins.ts` performs NO Storage delete (textures and busts overwrite their own derived paths), so `isOwnSkinPath` is exported for future callers, not used there — stated in its header. The other CHECKs follow the `mentions` naming: `skins_slug_format` (`^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{1,62}[a-z0-9])$`), `skins_name_length` (1..60), `skins_description_md_length` (≤ 5000), `skins_downloads_check` (≥ 0), `art_slug_format`, `art_title_length` (1..80), `art_width_check` / `art_height_check` (1..8192), `art_year_check` (null or 2015..2100), `art_credit_format` (null, or ≤ 40 and `^[A-Za-z0-9_ .-]*$`); uniques `skins_slug_key`, `art_slug_key`.
3. **Storage paths (04 SC-21 idiom — DB-stored paths are bucket-prefixed).** `skins/{skin_id}/texture.png`, `skins/{skin_id}/bust.png`, `art/{art_id}/{hash16}.{png|jpg|webp}`; art's `begin` pending path is `art/{art_id}/{uuid}.{ext}` (the `projectMediaPendingPath` precedent), moved to `{hash16}` at commit. For `createArt` the `art_id` is minted at `begin` (`crypto.randomUUID()`) and travels INSIDE the path; `commit` parses it back. Builders / parsers in `lib/files.ts`: `skinTexturePath(id)`, `skinBustPath(id)`, `artPendingPath(id, ext)`, `artFinalPath(id, hash16, ext)`, `parseArtPendingPath(path) → { artId, ext } | null`, `parseArtPendingPathFor(artId, path) → { ext } | null`, `parseArtFinalPath(path) → { artId, hash16, ext } | null`, `type ArtExt = 'png' | 'jpg' | 'webp'`, `SKINS_BUCKET = 'skins'`, `ART_BUCKET = 'art'`.
4. **Schema as built (migration `20260925120000_skins_art.sql`; data-model §2.4 amended).** Enums `skin_model ('classic','slim')`, `skin_status ('draft','published')`, `art_kind ('avatar','thumbnail','icon','render','other')`, `art_status ('draft','published')`. `skins` = the §2.4 columns + `created_at`, `updated_at` (the shared `set_updated_at` trigger), the D2 CHECKs, index `skins_status_sort_idx (status, sort_order, created_at desc)`; `art` likewise with `art_status_sort_idx`. Revoke-first grants (select to anon + authenticated; insert / update / delete to authenticated; all to service_role); RLS `<t>_select_published_or_admin` (`status = 'published' or public.is_admin()`) and `<t>_insert_admin` / `<t>_update_admin` / `<t>_delete_admin` (`is_admin()`) — a moderator is a plain D on every write. The buckets and their two read policies live in the SAME migration (one concern: "the skins + art schema"): `skins` public, `file_size_limit 524288` (the bust ceiling — the 64 KB texture ceiling is `validateUpload(bytes,'skin')`'s, 04 U4, enforced in the action), `allowed_mime_types ['image/png']`; `art` public, `10485760`, png / jpeg / webp; `skins_public_read` / `art_public_read` (select to anon + authenticated); NO insert / update / delete policy on `storage.objects` for either bucket — only the service role writes (01 INV-33; T-RLS-121 / 122 "write D for every JWT role"). `lib/supabase/types.ts` regenerated (+110 lines; nothing else changed).
5. **RPCs (migration `20260925120100_skins_art_rpcs.sql`; data-model §2.11 / §4 amended).** `record_skin_download(p_skin_id uuid) returns void` = `update skins set downloads = downloads + 1 where id = p_skin_id and status = 'published'`; no row → `raise exception 'record_skin_download: unknown or unpublished skin %'` (P0001, no custom errcode — the `record_download` fail-closed twin). `reorder_skins(p_items jsonb) returns integer` and `reorder_art(p_items jsonb) returns integer` are copies of `reorder_mentions` (ADR-0045 D2) over `skins` / `art`: one `update … from jsonb_to_recordset` statement, P0002 when a listed id matches no row (nothing applied), 22023 on a malformed payload (not an array, an item without `id` / `sort_order`, an id twice), an empty array → 0. All three: `security definer`, `search_path = public`, `volatile`, EXECUTE revoked from every role and granted to `service_role` only. T-RLS-129 gains the catalog + behaviour legs for all three (the "asserted absent" clause of the S1.3 row is removed).
6. **`createSkin` / `updateSkin` as built (04 §1.5 Input / Effects / Returns amended).** Schemas in `lib/actions/skins.schema.ts` (ADR-0013 pattern): `createSkinInput` arrives as `FormData` from the `SkinForm` island (`runAction` converts), so the keys are form-shaped — `slug` (the shared slug rule), `name` 1..60, `description_md` ≤ 5000 (blank → undefined on create, `null` = clear on a patch), `model` `'classic' | 'slim'`, `is_exclusive` (`'true'` / `true` → on, anything else off, absent → false), `status` (default `'draft'`), `sort_order` (`'3'` → 3, blank / absent → 0 on create, "not sent" on a patch), `texture: File` (required on create). `updateSkinInput` is a `z.union` — the FLAT patch `{ id, …keys }` (at least one key besides `id`; the island builds `FormData`, so no `{id, patch}` envelope) | `{ reorder: [{ id, sort_order }] }` ≤ `SKIN_REORDER_MAX = 200`; an input fitting neither form fails as ONE root issue with path `''` (the `updateMentionInput` behaviour — the forms route it to their `<p role="alert">`). `createSkin`: `requireRole('admin')` → `assertRateLimit('upload:skins', …)` → validate the texture (D7) → INSERT the row first (id minted, `texture_path = skins/<id>/texture.png`; a slug 23505 → `conflict` on `slug` with NO object written) → upload the texture to that path (`upsert: true`, `image/png`, cache-control 1 y; an upload failure after the insert DELETES the row again and answers `storage_error` — a skin without its texture is not a skin) → AWAIT `renderSkinBust(id)` (a render failure is not a save failure: `render_bust_path` stays NULL, the answer is `ok` with `bust_rendered: false`) → `revalidateTag('skins')` once → SC-24 line. `updateSkin` patch: only the keys present are written; unknown `id` → `not_found` ("That skin doesn't exist."); a `texture` is validated, uploaded to the SAME path, `render_bust_path` cleared in the same update, then the job runs and the row is re-read; **`bust_rendered` = "the row now carries a cached bust"** (a metadata-only patch on a never-rendered skin also answers `false`, so the form's "will render later" line stays true). `updateSkin` reorder → RPC `reorder_skins` (P0002 → `not_found` "One of those skins doesn't exist.", nothing applied). Result shapes: `CreateSkinData = { skin: SkinRow; bust_rendered: boolean }`, `UpdateSkinData = { skin; bust_rendered } | { reordered: number }`; exports `SKIN_MODEL`, `SKIN_STATUS`, `SKIN_NAME_MAX = 60`, `SKIN_DESCRIPTION_MAX = 5000`, the input / `*Values` / row types.
7. **Texture validation order (04 §1.5 Validation amended; refines the brief's D-R8).** bytes → `pngDimensions`: a PNG whose IHDR is not exactly 64×64 → `validation` on field `texture` with the VERBATIM "Skins need to be 64×64." (T-ACT-58, T-E2E-38); bytes that are not a PNG (a JPEG named `.png`, a PNG signature with no IHDR) and the 64 KB cap → `validateUpload(bytes, 'skin')`'s own copy ("That's a .jpg. Allowed: .png", "That's 100 KB. The limit is 64.", "That's not a readable PNG. Skins are 64×64."). `lib/validation/files.ts` messages are unchanged (T-UNIT-18). The `UploadWell` pick mode (D18) applies the same 64×64 check client-side with the same words.
8. **`createArt` / `updateArt` as built (04 §1.4.5 U3 + §1.5 Input / Effects amended).** Schemas in `lib/actions/art.schema.ts`: `createArtInput` = `z.discriminatedUnion('phase')` — `begin { filename, size_bytes ≤ 10_485_760, mime ∈ image/png | jpeg | webp }` | `commit { path, slug, title 1..80, kind, year?: 2015..currentYear+1 | null, credit?: ≤ 40 /^[A-Za-z0-9_ .-]*$/ | null, downloadable?, status? (default draft), sort_order? }` (plain objects — the island sends JSON, not FormData); `updateArtInput` = `z.union` of `{ reorder }` ≤ `ART_REORDER_MAX = 200` | the phase union `begin { id, filename, size_bytes, mime }` | `commit { id, path?, …every metadata key optional }` (≥ 1 key besides `id` / `phase`); `z.object` strips unknown keys, so a client-supplied `width` / `height` is ignored. `createArt` `begin`: `requireRole('admin')` → `assertRateLimit('upload:art', …)` → mint the id → `createSignedUpload(ART_BUCKET, artPendingPath(id, ext))` → `{ path, token, signed_url }`, no row. `commit`: the echoed `path` must be `art/<uuid>/<uuid>.<ext>` (INV-53) — a path outside that pattern → `forbidden` "That path isn't one of ours.", the object untouched; a well-formed path whose id is an EXISTING row's → `forbidden` (another row's folder — also refuses re-creating a row from its own final path); a well-formed pending path under a FREE id that nobody PUT to is indistinguishable from an un-PUT `begin`, so it answers `validation` on `path` "That upload never arrived. Send the file first." (the object of the real begin untouched — T-ACT-73's art leg pins THIS, not `forbidden`) → download the bytes → `validateUpload(bytes,'art')` (magic / size; fail → delete the PENDING object → `validation`) → `imageDimensions` via sharp (undecodable → "That file didn't open as an image."; a side > 8192 → "That's W×H. Pictures can be up to 8192 pixels a side."; both delete the pending object) → move to `artFinalPath(id, contentHash16(bytes), ext)` with `ext` from the SNIFFED mime (`mediaExtForMime`; a webp PUT under a png `begin` is stored as `.webp`) → insert the row with the server-derived `width` / `height` (a slug 23505 → `conflict` on `slug`; the object STAYS at its final path). U3 on `path`: a commit re-sent with the FINAL path of the same id (the admin fixed the slug) is accepted — the bytes are downloaded again to re-derive `width` / `height`, nothing is moved; a failing FINAL-path object is left in place (it is the row's image or a stray U1 cleans), only a failing PENDING object is deleted. `updateArt` `begin` mints a pending path under the EXISTING id (`not_found` "That piece doesn't exist." otherwise); `commit` writes only the keys present (`year: null` / `credit: null` and a blank string clear), a `path` goes through the same parse scoped to this id (`parseArtPendingPathFor` / the final form) → validate → move → `image_path` / `width` / `height` in the same update → the OLD object deleted per D2; `{ reorder }` → RPC `reorder_art` (P0002 → `not_found` "One of those pieces doesn't exist."). `revalidateTag('art')` once per call. Result shapes: `SignedUploadData = { path; token; signed_url }`, `CreateArtData = SignedUploadData | { art: ArtRow }`, `UpdateArtData = SignedUploadData | { art } | { reordered }`; exports `ART_KIND`, `ART_STATUS`, `ART_TITLE_MAX = 80`, `ART_CREDIT_MAX = 40`, `ART_YEAR_MIN = 2015`, `ART_CREDIT_RE`.
9. **Rate-limit counting rule (04 §5.5 amended).** `upload:skins` (60 / h / admin) is counted on EVERY `createSkin` / `updateSkin` call — patch and reorder included; `upload:art` (60 / h / admin) on every `createArt` / `updateArt` `begin` (U2 — a `begin` counts even without a commit) and on every metadata-only / reorder call, but NOT on a commit that carries a `path` (that upload was counted at its `begin`). Scopes existed in `lib/rate-limit.ts`; no new scope.
10. **`renderSkinBust` job as built (04 §3.8 amended).** `lib/jobs/renderSkinBust.ts` is a plain module (no `server-only`, no `next/*`, no `revalidateTag` — the action revalidates after the job; loadable by plain Node through D11): `renderSkinBust(skinId, deps?) → Promise<{ ok: true; path } | { ok: false; error }>`, never throws; `deps = { db?: JobDb; render?: typeof renderBustPng; now?; timeoutMs? }` (`RENDER_TIMEOUT_MS = 20_000`). Steps inside a `Promise.race` budget WITH CHECKPOINTS after every await (a render that finishes after the timeout never uploads or updates — T-ACT-56 proves it with a 900 ms render under a 400 ms budget): read `skins.texture_path, model` (service client) → download the texture bytes → `renderBustPng` (ADR-0047) → upload `skins/<id>/bust.png` (`upsert: true`, `image/png`, cache-control 1 y) → `update skins set render_bust_path` (the path is derived from `skinId`, never read from input — the D2 CHECK binds it). A failure at any step is ONE `log.error` line (`job: 'renderSkinBust'`, `msg: 'bust_render_failed'`, `id` = the skin id — the job has no `sync_runs` row of its own, `meta: { step, name, code, ms }` — never bytes or paths) and `{ ok: false, error }` with a plain step word (`'render failed'`, `'download failed'`, `'read failed'`, `'timeout'`). Writes NO `sync_runs` row (the script owns that).
11. **`scripts/render-skins.mjs` + `scripts/lib/ts-loader.mjs` as built (04 §3.8 batch; 01 §1 tree + `_registry.md` scripts line amended).** `run({ listSkins, render, insertRun, finalizeRun, force = false, log = console.log }) → Promise<{ exitCode, summary: { runId, total, due, rendered, failed, skipped, errors[≤ 20] } }>` is the whole program with its edges injected (the `wait-for-schema.mjs` shape; exports `dueSkins`, `parseArgs`, `ROOT`, `ERRORS_MAX = 20`); due = `render_bust_path IS NULL` (or all with `--force`), rendered in sequence ordered `sort_order`, `created_at desc`; ONE `sync_runs` row `source='skins'` inserted before the first render and finalized after — `items` = rendered count, `ok = true` whenever the run itself completed, `error` set ONLY when every due skin failed (else null), a finalize failure logged with exit 0; exit 1 only when the list / insert threw before the first render. 'slim' : 'default', pixelRatio: 'match-device' })`, zoom 0.85, the controls on a solid slab inside the `--slab-sunk` well (3:4 under 900px, 4:3 above): Spin / Walk are toggles with `aria-pressed`, Front ⇄ Back is one button whose label is the ACTION offered ("Back" while facing front, "Front" after the flip); the three are native `<button>`s wearing `Button.module.css` classes (`data-variant="secondary" data-size="sm"`) plus a pressed style (indigo fill) because the `Button` primitive has no `aria-pressed` pass-through (exported as `SkinViewer3DControls` so the loading shell and the leaf share one row; an additive `'aria-pressed'` on `Button` would let them become `<Button secondary size="sm">`); skinview3d's OrbitControls stay on for drag-rotate only (zoom / pan off, polar angle fenced ±0.6 rad) and its inline `touch-action: none` is overridden to `pan-y` so vertical page scroll survives on phone. Bust: 3:4, one frame then `renderPaused`, transparent background, camera `(0, 12, 40)` → `(0, 7, 0)`, fov 40, yaw −25° (tuned from the spike's `(0, 20, 34)` → `(0, 12, 0)`, which put the crown on the top edge), no controls, `touch-action: auto`. Here's the render."; no canvas, no controls. `prefers-reduced-motion`: Spin starts off and Walk is disabled (`matchMedia` in the leaf). Texture fetch = skinview3d's own image load of the Supabase public URL (03 C-17 exception 2; no CSP change). **Draw loop (integration refinement, same decision):** the stage loop runs only while something moves — Spin, Walk or an orbit drag (OrbitControls `start` → `end`); a still model is `renderPaused` and draws one frame on demand (texture in, Front/Back, a toggle switched off, a resize, a drag's last step), the bust variant stays one-frame as before. An idle viewer costs no GPU; the `/dev/components` stage specimens start with Spin off so the gallery never runs several GL loops at once. 18. **`UploadWell` gains two additive modes (03 §2.10 row amended; 03 C-03).** `kind` widened to `'project-media' | 'project-file' | 'skin' | 'art'`; `action` optional (only in pick mode); `onPick?: (file: File | null) => void` — **pick mode**: after the client pre-check (size / extension; for `skin` additionally the first 24 bytes are read and `pngDimensions` must be 64×64 — the verbatim "Skins need to be 64×64.") the well goes `done` and hands the `File` to the parent; no `begin`, no PUT, no commit; the done row says a visually-hidden "Chosen". `onUploaded?: (pending: { path; filename; sizeBytes } | null) => void` — **deferred-commit mode**: `begin` → PUT → `done` reading "Ready to save." WITHOUT calling `commit`; the parent form sends `path` in its own commit call. Precedence: `onPick` wins over `onUploaded`; with neither the two-phase path is unchanged (a two-phase well with no `action` reports the PUT_FAILED line rather than throwing). Both modes hand the parent `null` at the start of every pick and on Remove / Try again, so a file the well no longer shows is never submitted. The limits line for a kind with a fixed size and a sub-MB cap prints "png · 64×64 · 64 KB max" (the MB rounding would have said 0 MB); art prints "png · jpg · webp · 10 MB per image" through the existing media branch. The media-MIME pre-check now applies to every non-`project-file` kind (so `skin` / `art` get the PUT `Content-Type` / type-copy behaviour `project-media` had; the `project-media` outcome is identical). `ProjectFileWell` unchanged; existing tests green.

27. **The admin forms and pages — decisions taken inside D19's frame by the admin build (02 §1.3 / 03 §2.10 rows amended; recorded so the design and frontend gates read them as decided, not as findings).** (a) The table / ORDER texture thumb is the 64×64 PNG drawn at **32px inside a 40px `--ink` well** (`unoptimized`, `image-rendering: pixelated`) — the brief said a 40px thumb, but DESIGN.md §4 asks for integer scale and 0.625× would uneven the texel rows; the half step keeps every row even. The art thumb is 48px `next/image fill` + `object-fit: contain` through the optimizer (`remotePatterns` cover the local Supabase origin) — natural aspect, never cropped (DESIGN.md §6 #6). (b) The submit word is **"Save"** (`Button` primary) on both forms, create and edit — the brief's copy list had no submit word and its T-E2E-38 recipe says "→ Save →"; the section headings are verbatim (ADD A SKIN / EDIT SKIN / ADD ART / EDIT ART / ORDER / ALL SKINS / ALL ART) and "Cancel" is a ghost link back to the bare URL beside the EDIT heading. (c) Save with no texture / picture answers inline WITHOUT a call — "Drop the 64×64 PNG in first." / "Add a picture first." (`role="alert"` under the well; DESIGN.md §7 voice) — the create schema would otherwise answer a `texture` / `path` issue after a round trip. (d) The well sits in a `role="group"` named by its "Texture" / "Replace texture" / "Image" / "Replace image" label (`UploadWell` has no label prop; its drop zone is its own `<label>`) and is remounted through a `key` after a successful create (it has no reset prop) so it returns to `idle`; on an art create slug `conflict` the form clears the pending path, remounts the well and adds "Fix the slug, then drop the picture again." — the form holds only the pending path the well handed over (no `File`, no bytes, so it cannot derive the hash16), and a re-submit with the pending path would answer "That upload never arrived" (the D19 consequence; the object at the final path is an orphan until U1's sweep). (e) Error placement (`placeErrors`): an issue lands on its root key only for keys with a `Field` (skins: slug, name, description_md, sort_order, texture; art: slug, title, year, credit, sort_order, path); `Select` keys (model, kind, status), the booleanish keys and a union root issue at path `''` go to the one general `role="alert"` line; `error.field` (a `conflict` → slug) fills the field when no issue already did; non-validation codes → the line. (f) An EDIT sends every key, not a diff (D19): an emptied Description clears (`''` → `null` through the schema's `blankToNull`), an unticked switch turns `is_exclusive` / `downloadable` off (an absent checkbox would keep the stored value), blank `year` / `credit` → `null` — so a "Nothing to change." root issue can never fire from the form. (g) "Rendering the 3D preview…" shows only while pending AND a texture is attached (a metadata-only edit renders nothing, so it would lie); the render-later line (`bust_rendered === false`) is a `role="status"` line beside the button, kept after a create's reset — it describes the save that just happened. (h) Pages: `?edit=` is UUID-checked BEFORE `getAdminSkin` / `getAdminArt` (a non-uuid would be a 22P02 → 500); an unknown / unreadable id (a moderator on a draft) silently opens the create form; the island is keyed by the row id (`?edit=A` → `?edit=B` restarts its state). ORDER renders only when at least one row is published (the mentions FEATURED ORDER precedent; a draft joins the list the moment it is published — T-E2E-38 asserts 2 → 3); its help line names the public effect ("The order on /skins, top to bottom; the first one opens by default."). (i) For moderators the row's Edit control STAYS A LINK (`?edit=<id>` opens the same island in `readOnly`): it mutates nothing, so the 03 §2.10 rule (mutation controls disabled) does not apply — T-E2E-38's moderator pass asserts two Edit links present; Publish / Unpublish, the reorder handles + Move buttons, every field, the switch, the well's picker and Save are natively `disabled` under `title="Admin only"` with no `<form>`. Moderators see published rows only (RLS), so ORDER and the table never show them a draft; the create form is still rendered, read-only, per the "never hidden" rule. (j) **No pass-3 artboard exists for the admin Skins / Art forms** (the prototypes carry only the sidebar entries and the upload well), so both pages and islands follow the `/admin/mentions` page + `MentionPreview` slab idiom (`--slab` panel, 2px `--line-soft` outline, two field columns from the tablet floor) and DESIGN.md §5 Admin field / table — for the design gate to confirm, not a finding.

### Notes — built details judged within the spec's latitude (no deviation; listed so `spec-drift-reviewer` can check them)
- `app/api/download/[fileId]/route.ts` keeps D1 / D3 / D6 / D7 and the 405 rule verbatim; the only edits are the union call sites (D1).
- `lib/actions/skins.ts` / `art.ts`: `requireRole('admin')` first, service client after, one keys-only `msg:'admin'` line before every `ok` (SC-24), `runAction` everywhere (ADR-0013); a moderator is `forbidden` (ADR-0002 C7; T-ACT-57 / 60).
- `SkinViewer3D.tsx` is the ONE `next/dynamic` site for skinview3d and `SkinViewer3D.Canvas.tsx` the ONE importer (`grep -rn "skinview3d" components` → that file; `grep -rn "next/dynamic" components` → `SkinViewer3D.tsx`, `Gallery.tsx`, `ArtMasonry.Lightbox.tsx` — the `Lightbox` sites 03 C-18 names).
- Islands never fetch: `SkinsStage` / `ArtGallery` / the forms take props; the only network is the Server Actions, `UploadWell`'s PUT, skinview3d's texture load and `trackEvent` (01 INV-09).
- `/skins` and `/art` are ISR 600 with no `searchParams` / `cookies()` / `headers()` read (02 RP-02 / RP-03; `next build` marks them ISR — SM-29).
- The `download` analytics payload is the 04 §5.6 shape as written; T-UNIT-38's allowlist is unchanged (`from` already contained `'skin'`).
- Every `.module.css` is tokens-only (`node scripts/contrast.mjs --check styles/` → OK); the S1.7 CSS uses existing tokens (`--slab-sunk`, `--line-soft`, `--indigo-lift`, `--indigo-deep`, `--space-18`, `--text-body`, `--font-display` …) — no new token, no new `data-state` value beyond the 03 §3 rows, hence no DESIGN.md edit (ADR-R8 not triggered).
- Gate notes for Session B: `security-reviewer` — the ownership surface is D2 (`grep -n "isOwnArtPath\|isOwnSkinPath" lib` → `lib/files.ts` + `lib/actions/art.ts`; the three CHECKs in the migration), the upload surface is D7 / D8 (`validateUpload` before every write, dimensions server-derived, the pending object deleted on failure, `forbidden` never reveals whether an id exists beyond "taken"); `backend-reviewer` — D10's checkpoints and D11's `sync_runs` rules; `supabase-reviewer` — D4 / D5 and the bucket policies; `frontend-reviewer` — D13's five rows, T-E2E-8's chunk method, the `/skins` fallback risk in D16.

## Alternatives considered
| Alternative | Why not |
|---|---|
| An `if (kind === 'skin')` branch per kind in the route (D1) | Every future kind (`workroom_file`, S2.3) would grow the chain; the union carries its own RPC payload and URL kind (01 INV-56 "generic"). |
| A `record_skin_download` custom errcode the route switches on (D1) | The `record_download` twin has none; the route answers 500 `internal` for any counter failure either way (04 §2.3 Errors). |
| Skip the DB CHECKs and rely on the app-side re-check alone (D2) | The 2026-08-20 rule asks for both: the CHECK refuses a mis-pointed row before any delete can be asked. |
| Upload the skin texture before inserting the row (D6) | A slug conflict answered after the upload leaves an object under a folder that never gets a row (U1 excludes skins from the orphan sweep). |
| Dims-first strictly, then `validateUpload` (D7) | A JPEG named `.png` has no IHDR — it would get the 64×64 words instead of the type copy T-ACT-58 asks for. |
| Answer `forbidden` for a swapped FREE art id (D8) | Indistinguishable from an un-PUT `begin` without a begin ledger; a ledger is a table for an error message. |
| Count `upload:art` on every commit too (D9) | A path commit was counted at its `begin`; double-counting halves the admin's real allowance. |
| Revalidate `skins` from the bulk script (D11) | The script runs outside Next; the busts are previews that appear within the ISR window anyway. |
| `lib/data/skins.ts` importing `publicObjectUrl` from `lib/files.ts` (D12) | `lib/files.ts` imports the admin client — the INV-14 fence; `publicStorageUrl` yields the same string. |
| Import `skinview3d` directly in `SkinViewer3D.tsx` under `next/dynamic` (D13) | The dynamic site would bundle the package into the parent's chunk graph; a leaf file keeps one importer and one lazy chunk. |
| `Skeleton` in the `SkinCard` slot until the job fills it (D15) | A skin whose render failed would show a grey box for ever; 00 AC3 says client-render fallback. |
| Details slab under the 4:3 stage at every width (D16) | 900px of viewer before the first control on a 1200px page; the phone / tablet layout keeps the sentence literally. |
| Show the download count on the stage (D16) | DESIGN.md §6 #5 does not list it; `0 ↓` under every seed skin reads badly. |
| `?kind=render` with no render → the empty state (D17) | A bar with nothing highlighted over an empty masonry; the `SeenOnGrid` rule already treats unoffered values as absent. |
| A `Button` `aria-pressed` prop for the viewer toggles (D14) | Additive and welcome later (03 C-03); native buttons wearing the Button classes needed no primitive change in a six-agent pass. |
| Two `UploadWell` components (pick / deferred) (D18) | 03 C-17 exception 4 names ONE component allowed to PUT; two modes on one island keep the exception narrow. |
| `getComputedStyle` for `height: auto` in T-E2E-9 (D21) | Resolves to the used px value — the assertion could never pass; the Typed OM reads the declared value. |
| Keep `placeholders.spec.ts` with an empty list (D21) | Nothing left to assert; T-E2E-46's row now says so. |

## Consequences
- Positive: one download route for both kinds with no per-kind chain (S2.3's `workroom_file` adds a union arm); a mis-pointed `*_path` row is refused by the database and a service-role delete never touches another row's object; a slug conflict writes no object; the admin sees "Skins need to be 64×64." for the case it names and the type copy otherwise; art ids are minted server-side and travel inside the path; the busts render in the action's own function with a real, tested client fallback; `/skins` and `/art` stay ISR with shareable `?skin=` / `?kind=` URLs and the same markup in the fallback; every S1.7 island is on the C-16a list and `check-client-islands` passes; the e2e run has WebGL without a GPU.
- Negative: `createSkin` holds a published row for a few ms without its texture object (an upload failure removes it; a crash between insert and upload leaves a row whose texture 404s until a re-upload); the desktop `/skins` arrangement differs from DESIGN.md §6 #5's sentence until its next revision; a `/skins` visit could, on a warm cache, build one GL context that is disposed at once (D16 risk); `?kind=render` with no render shows all instead of an empty state; the `updateSkin` / `updateArt` unions answer a shapeless input with one root issue rather than per-field ones; `/dev/components` under `pnpm dev` is broken by pre-existing labels (D26); T-ACT-56's budget leg assumes the local read + download finish inside 400 ms (bump if CI shows it); T-E2E-38 leaves `rate_limit_hits` rows for `upload:skins` / `upload:art` behind and any axe pass placed right after an admin save needs the `settledButton` guard (D28); an art create slug conflict costs a second drop and an orphan object until U1 (D27 d).
- Follow-ups: the two DESIGN.md readings (D16 desktop arrangement, D17 caption strip) → `docs/questions.md` "For DESIGN.md's next revision"; the six over-long gallery labels (D26) → the integrator or the next fix pass; `Button` `'aria-pressed'` pass-through (D14) → the next fix pass (03 C-03 additive); a `createArt` slug `conflict` that carries the final path so the admin need not drop the picture twice (D19; 04 §1.5) → the next fix pass; `projects.spec.ts`'s stale header comment (D21) → the integrator; Session B flips this ADR and ADR-0047 to Accepted at merge (`keep-docs`); production's first `createSkin` renders on Vercel's libvips (ADR-0047 D7 — nothing compares bytes across environments).
